headline: Leo Rolly Carnando And Daniel Marthin Finish As Hong Kong Open Runner-up
seoTitle: Leo Rolly Carnando and Daniel Marthin Finish Hong Kong Open
metaDescription: Indonesian men's doubles pair Leo Rolly Carnando and Daniel Marthin conclude their Hong Kong Open 2026 campaign as runner-up after the tournament final.
aiSummaryBullets: Leo Rolly Carnando and Daniel Marthin secured the runner-up position at the Hong Kong Open 2026.
The tournament final held at The Kai Tak Arena concluded on November 22, 2026.
The pair intends to use the experience gained during this event as preparation for the upcoming badminton season.
aiContextParagraph: The 2026 Hong Kong Open badminton tournament concluded at The Kai Tak Arena on November 22, 2026. The competition saw participation from several Indonesian athletes across different categories. Throughout the week, notable performances included the men's doubles pair Leo Rolly Carnando and Daniel Marthin reaching the final match of the tournament. The duo eventually finished as runner-up. Other Indonesian representatives, such as the mixed doubles pair Dejan Ferdinansyah and Gloria Emanuelle Widjaja, as well as the women's doubles team Apriyani Rahayu and Siti Fadia Silva Ramadhanti, also made significant progress by advancing through the quarterfinal and semifinal stages of the competition. The participants have indicated that their collective results in this tournament serve as important evaluation points for their ongoing development and preparations for the following professional season.
whyItIsViral: The tournament results have gained attention due to the consistent performance of Indonesian athletes throughout the event, covered by three independent media outlets.
